name: io.github.redd34/nightshift-grid
title: Nightshift Grid
description: Cited knowledge graphs from local documents, extracted by small Ollama models on idle machines.

environmentVariables.name: NIGHTSHIFT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Coordinator URL. Leave unset to use the grid started by `nightshift up` on this machine.

environmentVariables.name: NIGHTSHIFT_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the coordinator client token (only needed with NIGHTSHIFT_URL).

environmentVariables.name: NIGHTSHIFT_MCP_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the server may read documents from (default: the current directory).
